title: Choose AttendTa's visual world
question: Four directions for the replacement visual world, shown on the same screen: Organization Members. Keep the assigned direction, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Lanyard
options.lineage: Philippine campus ID cards, laminate, and the gate logbook
options.thesis: Every person is one laminated identity plate that gains a printed band as they move from request to certificate.
options.viewport: An ink institutional band with the logo tile and keyed nav, then a full-width roster where every name leads with a 30px identity plate.
options.risk: An ID-card world can read as an HR badge system: cold, corporate, and processing students instead of welcoming them.

raised.raise: State is line form before hue: solid, dashed, half-height and struck bands carry status, so it survives grayscale and colour blindness.
One earned accent plane: exactly one saturated teal field per screen, earned by the primary object or action.
A fixed magnitude ramp ranks report data by size and weight, never by colour family.
Registered and waitlisted are hard halves with a physical divide, never blended into one list.

options.label: Record Book
options.lineage: the registrar's ruled ledger and the class record book
options.thesis: The roster is a ruled ledger: every row is a posted entry and every decision leaves a stamp in the margin.
options.viewport: A bone sheet under an ink band, the roster ruled into columns with a teal margin rule and a POSTED stamp on the page head.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on, and a serif roster can read as a newspaper.

options.label: Marginalia
options.lineage: an annotated reference edition with a centre rail of keys
options.thesis: The record sits in the main column and its audit trail hangs in the margin, bracketed back to the line it belongs to.
options.viewport: A roster in the main column, a vermilion lifecycle rail, and the audit trail bracketed into a wide annotation margin.
options.risk: Two-column apparatus is hostile to a ten-column roster, and small serif at projector distance is hard to read.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: the audit trail becomes the margin, but the two-column measure fights the roster.

options.label: Plate Section
options.lineage: a design annual's plate section on uncoated stock
options.thesis: Every record is a registered plate: hairlines, crosshairs, and one letterpressed seal to prove a human signed it.
options.viewport: A near-white sheet of hairlines and registration crosshairs, with a rotating letterpress stamp half off the page head.
options.risk: A designer's world, not a student org's: identification is thin and hairlines can read cold.
options.case: Fuses cleanly on clarity; loses on identification because a design annual is not a student's world.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Participants plot as magnitudes on a chart, importance carried by dot size on a fixed ramp.
options.viewport: A navy chart ground where members plot as magnitude-scaled dots inside a coordinate grid.
options.risk: Dot-size hierarchy cannot carry tabular attendance data.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dot-size hierarchy cannot carry a ten-column roster.
options.kept: Magnitude as a fixed rank ramp.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.lineage: a Wim Crouwel gridded type specimen
options.thesis: The layout grid stays visible and every element snaps to its cells.
options.viewport: A visible construction grid with the roster snapped to cells and one saturated accent plane.
options.risk: A visible grid is a designer's reference; students do not identify with a type specimen.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the visible grid is a designer's reference, not a student's.
options.kept: One saturated plane earned by the primary object.

options.label: J-Card
options.thesis: The roster is a folded inlay with two hard halves and running figures ruled to the margin.
options.viewport: A folded inlay sheet with side A / side B halves and running figures tight to the margin.
options.risk: A retro artifact the audience knows as nostalgia, not as their daily record system.
options.case: Fuses partly: two hard halves help, but the folded card has no counterpart in the product.
options.kept: Hard two-half splits and figures tight to the margin.

options.label: Emission Rail
options.lineage: a spectrogram's emission-line rail on a viewing box
options.thesis: State is carried by line form and position on one calibrated rail, never by hue.
options.viewport: A charcoal continuum with bone legends and needle-thin emission lines carrying every state.
options.risk: A lab instrument's grammar applied to a working screen reads as costume.
options.case: Fuses poorly as a world, but its state grammar is the strongest donation in the hand.
options.kept: State encoded as line form, not hue.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A left sidebar, a top bar, three summary tiles, and a rounded table with status pills.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
